rule.name: ParameterizedLogMessage
rule.message: Use SLF4J placeholders for values in a log message.
rule.description: Keep runtime values out of concatenated classic and fluent log messages.

property.name: xpath
property.value: //MethodCall[@MethodName = ('trace', 'debug', 'info', 'warn', 'error', 'log', 'setMessage')] [*[1][pmd-java:typeIs('org.slf4j.Logger') or pmd-java:typeIs('org.slf4j.spi.LoggingEventBuilder')]] /ArgumentList/*[ (position() = 1 and not(pmd-java:typeIs('org.slf4j.Marker'))) or (position() = 2 and ../*[1][pmd-java:typeIs('org.slf4j.Marker')]) ]/descendant-or-self::InfixExpression [@Operator = '+' and pmd-java:typeIs('java.lang.String') and @CompileTimeConstant = false()]

rule.name: NoPersonalLogArgument
rule.message: Log an ID instead of a login, email address, or workspace slug.
rule.description: Inspect known personal-data getters and argument names on typed SLF4J logger and builder calls.

property.name: xpath
